page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc6.16xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 3.1 GHz. It features 64 vCPUs, derived from 32 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, and 128.0 GB of RAM, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB. The instance operates on a KVM hypervisor and includes 35 MB of L3 cache, along with support for AVX-512 vector extensions and AES cryptography. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate strong performance in memory-intensive and instruction-extended workloads. The instance achieves a strong rating in large-block read-only memory bandwidth at 209.21 GB/sec and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression at 269.5 GB/sec. PassMark CPU extended instructions and database operations also rank in the top 25% tier. Conversely, the server exhibits average performance in standard single-core and multi-core CPU tests, such as stress-ng and Geekbench. Text generation speeds for small and medium language models are weak, registering at 56.49 tokens/sec and 8.69 tokens/sec respectively, which highlights a limitation for real-time generative AI workloads.

From a resource density perspective, the 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio offers qualitative cost efficiency for compute-bound workloads that do not require massive memory footprints. However, the lack of bundled local storage means users must provision external block storage, which may affect overall infrastructure latency and configuration. Given its high clock speed and strong database operation benchmarks, this instance is suitable for database operations, multi-threaded decompression tasks, software compilation, and general compute-heavy applications.
